hook.line: Cover card: 99 viral image prompts for ChatGPT.
hook.visual: Black frame, then a glitch reveal of a cream cover: big green '99 VIRAL IMAGE PROMPTS for ChatGPT' over a 3D ChatGPT logo with hand-written arrows.

beats.what: Black frame, glitch transition into the cover card
Cover: 99 viral image prompts for ChatGPT
Slide 1: numbered pill list of camera-angle commands (/4k, /cinematic, /aerialview)
Last slide: effect commands (89-99), held to the end

why_it_works: Each slide is too dense to read in 2.5 s, so viewers save or share to read later (2609 shares)
A big number in the cover promises a complete resource up front
Slides change on a steady 2.5 s rhythm (measured events every ~2.5 s) to a trending track
weaknesses: No voice and no face; nothing personal ties the list to the creator
Text is tiny and much of it sits outside the safe area (measured outside_safe_share 0.616)
Last slide is shown twice, wasting the end
for_robert: Close a reel with one saveable cheat-sheet slide of the prompts he used, so viewers save it; don't make the whole reel a silent slideshow.
